title: Config: TLS for outbound/inbound peering with cert pinning
description:
Peering connections are plain TCP with no transport security. Operator-to-operator links traverse the public internet in many deployments. Need TLS support for both outbound (transit connects to peer) and inbound (peer connects to transit).

Config additions needed:
  [tls]
  cert_path = "/etc/usenet-ipfs/server.pem"
  key_path  = "/etc/usenet-ipfs/server.key"

Per-peer cert_sha256 pin (see structured per-peer config issue) provides authentication of the remote end — prevents MITM even with self-signed certs.

Inbound: wrap TcpListener accept with rustls acceptor before handing to run_peering_session.
Outbound: wrap TcpStream connect with rustls connector using pinned cert check.

Plain TCP peers (no [tls] section) remain supported for LAN/loopback peering.
